hints.title: Bipartite Coordinate Split
hints.text: Split the digit sequence into two coordinate strings, then generate all valid decimal placements for each.

hints.title: Decimal Validity Rules
hints.text: A string without decimal cannot have leading zeroes unless it is 0. A string with decimal cannot have redundant leading zeroes before dot or trailing zeroes after dot.

hints.title: Cartesian Product Formatting
hints.text: Generate all valid representations for the left and right coordinate fragments and combine them into formatted coordinate pairs.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Enumerates split boundaries and decimal point placements.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arbitrary decimal insertions without numerical validity rules produce malformed representations like 01 or 1.0.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Result array stores all valid pairs in O(N^3) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Isolate validation helper for single coordinate string to cleanly apply leading and trailing zero constraints.
